name: Khazarad, Corner of Gate Wall and Forge Street
desc1: This broad, flagstone-lined street angles sharply in the northwestern
desc2: corner of the dwarven city. The cave wall to the north and west has
desc3: been worn flat, smoothed, and engraved with intricate, angular
desc4: designs. The Gate Wall continues off to the south, while Forge Street
desc5: heads off in an eastern direction.
